mods.name: [VSCRIPT] Ragdoll Magnitude & Drive Tweaks
mods.description:
This is a mod that makes the ragdolls similar to their L4D1 counterparts; very launchable. L4D2 made them to be rather static, so this mod fixes that. It also changes the "drive" which (could very well be placebo) launches the ragdoll in the direction they were attacked from.

This applies to all client sided ragdolls in the game, should work with all campaigns and mutations. Should also be compatible with custom .phy ragdolls. You will need a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1932686022]survivor ragdoll mod[/url] if you want to see survivor ragdolls.

[b]This mod is server-sided. It will only work locally or on dedicated servers, but only the host/server needs it[/b]

[b]Update: Now configurable![/b]

mods.name: Lux's Survivor Legs script
mods.description:
[b]NOTICE: This addon uses scripts. This will not work in Dedicated servers. Use local/listen servers, or singleplayer instead.[/b]
An upside to this is that if you can see this addon's effects, [i]everyone else can.[/i]

This is a port-to-VScript of [b][u]Lux's Survivor Legs plugin[/u][/b]. [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=299560]link here[b][/b][/url] [i](ah yes, reports galore)[/i]
Yes, it works with custom models. But it's not flawless, and you may face clipping or duplicate arm issues with them.

For the most part, it works like the plugin. Most of the internal workings are kept the same, albeit translated over to VScript.

It comes with displaying your pistols, throwable and health items on your legs. However, this can be buggy on multiplayer with people that have custom models.

[h1]Technical Stuff[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2865107042/3391798007030752899/]Click here to know about other features of this mod like changeable settings.[/url]

[u]Bugs:[/u]
[strike][i]- The USE button will occasionally be blocked due to the legs. Try looking more up or down.[/i][/strike] [i](Fix applied)[/i]
[strike][i]- The legs will take a few seconds to properly load when you spawn into the map, are respawned from a closet or revived by a defibrillator.[/i][/strike] [i](Fix applied)[/i]

[h1]Before you ask 'Does this work on Official Dedicated?'[/h1]
The only way for legs to work on Official Dedicated is to modify the viewmodels, just like the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2490500647]old and buggy viewmodel legs.[/url]
There's no way around it. Official Dedicated servers do not accept any script files.

All of the assets, including [i]CEDA [/i]warning flyers, the [i]Midnight Riders[/i] tour poster, government pamphlets, and other small details, were recreated[b] by hand by me, with no AI used whatsoever. [/b]The entire process took roughly one month to complete.

All loading screens are available in [b]4K[/b], but the mod also works great on [b]2K[/b] and [b]1080p[/b] monitors.

mods.name: Dublagem PT-BR | Bill
mods.description:
[h1]Dublagem PT-BR – Bill[/h1]

[b]O Bill falando português do Brasil![/b]

Este mod dubla o Bill em português brasileiro, com mais de 1.000 falas. Ele faz parte de um projeto maior, ainda em andamento, para dublar o Left 4 Dead 2 inteiro.

[h2]Dublagem completa do jogo[/h2]
Cada personagem é um item separado. Inscreva-se em todos para ter o jogo todo dublado:

[b]Sobreviventes de Left 4 Dead[/b]

[list]

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3821698573]Dublagem PT-BR – Rochelle[/url]

[b]NPCs e rádios[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3821690808]Dublagem PT-BR – NPCs e Rádios[/url] (Whitaker, Virgil, pilotos, rádios militares e mais)
[/list]

[h2]O que está incluído[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]1.093 falas do Bill[/b]: avisos de combate, reações, conversas das campanhas, The Sacrifice, The Passing e as campanhas do L4D1.
[*]Nomes oficiais dos infectados, os mesmos da tradução da Valve: Tanque, Bruxa, Gorfo, Fumacento, Caçador...
[*]Grunhidos, gritos de dor, risadas e outros sons sem fala continuam com o áudio original.
[/list]

Algumas falas:
[quote]"Primeiro a socorrer, último a morrer."
"Essa porta não vai se trancar sozinha, pessoal."
"SEBO NAS CANELAS!"
"O meu trabalho tá feito. Podem vir pra cima, filhos da mãe!"[/quote]

[h2]Projeto em andamento[/h2]
Próximos passos:
[list]
[*][b]Sincronia labial[/b]: fazer a boca dos personagens acompanhar a fala em português
[*]Revisar e refazer falas com base nos comentários de vocês
[/list]

[h2]Como foi feito[/h2]
[list]
[*]O roteiro foi adaptado do inglês para o português falado, usando as legendas oficiais da Valve como base, com o mesmo tom e personalidade de cada personagem.
[*][b]As vozes são geradas por inteligência artificial (TTS).[/b] São vozes sintéticas, escolhidas para se parecerem com o tom de cada personagem, e não clonam a voz dos atores originais.
[*]Cada fala foi dirigida para seguir a emoção e o ritmo da atuação original, com duração e volume ajustados.
[/list]

[h2]Problemas conhecidos[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]A boca não acompanha a fala.[/b] O jogo ainda usa a movimentação labial da versão em inglês. A correção está em desenvolvimento.
[*]Para caber no tempo de cada cena, algumas falas foram encurtadas em relação à legenda oficial, que continua mostrando o texto completo.
[*]Pode haver conflito com outros mods que substituem a voz do Bill.
[/list]

[h2]Dica para quem joga no Linux[/h2]
O português do Brasil não aparece na lista de idiomas do Steam no Linux, mas os textos em PT-BR existem no jogo. Para ativar, use esta opção de inicialização:
[code]-language brazilian[/code]

[h2]Ajude o projeto[/h2]
Achou uma fala estranha, cortada ou mal traduzida? Comente aqui dizendo o que o Bill disse e em que situação foi. Isso ajuda muito nas revisões.

Acompanhe as novidades no canal do Telegram: [url=https://t.me/lunosatc]t.me/lunosatc[/url]

[h2]Créditos[/h2]
Left 4 Dead 2 e todos os personagens pertencem à Valve. Este é um projeto de fã, gratuito e sem fins comerciais.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]English[/h2]
[b]Brazilian Portuguese voice-over for Bill[/b] (1,093 lines) from Left 4 Dead, part of a full set covering all eight survivors and the NPCs as separate items. This is a work in progress; lip sync is coming next. The voices are AI-generated (TTS) with synthetic voices, not clones of the original actors. Known issue: mouth movement still follows the English lines.

mods.name: xdReanimsBase (L4D2) Anim Mods base
mods.description:
[h1]Base dependency for 3-rd person re-animations mods for survivors and infected[/h1]

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Provides basic system of adding replacements for animations.
[*] Slot system that allows combining multiple re-animations mods. Up to 48 different slots per each character.
[*] When not provided new ones, original sequences are played instead. Implement only willing things.
[*] Has sequence orders already predefined for multiplayer gaming consistency, no more of painful sequence reordering for mod makers.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs and Limitations:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Conflicts with other animations mods.
[*] Doesn't alterate hitbox positions on servers without anim mods! Not recommended for competitive playing.
[*] Likewise, with anim mod installed locally, hitboxes locations are not visaully transferred to players without mods.
[*] Combining both mods on same character slot won't work. Random one will be picked instead. Ask modder to recompile to different slot or unpack and move the anim file to another slot, tutorial is in description.
[*] If both mods replace same sequence, the one from replacement with lowest slot number will have priority.
[*] It's currently not possible to replace some animations for stock model variants of some special infected as they have them embedded into models themselves instead of importing from animation mdl and thus having priority. A reanim compatible models of them are required to make them fully moddable.
[*] In stock variants, Francis and Louis have embedded animations. To optionally make them fully moddable, install [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2640924497]Francis[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2640922701]Louis[/url] Reanims Compatible variants or search Reanims Compatible replacement models of them. Without proper support, it's not possible to replace Healing and Rifle animations.
[*] Custom models must have original skeletons.
[*] You can't add new sequences for common zombies, this will break sequences order. You can, however, replace existing. If you need to extend animations with layers, you can replace and use any other -delta or -layer as long as it doesn't break something else.
[*] To replace Tank "Idle" $sequence, have it named as "Idle_xdr".
[/list]
